desc: Second forms of a Boki (docs/boki/GEODEMOLE_FORMS.md). A Boki with an entry here shows its 'cracked' look instead of its base look while its health is below damaged_below (fraction of max) in a match, or while it is sick at home. Same Boki, same stats: a look swap only. 'art' names the approved 2D art; 'model' is the 3D model file, empty until it exists, and then the base look is used for both forms.
